# tryjinai.com

> tryjinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is an AI outbound agent for B2B marketing teams. It reads a team's marketing context, picks target accounts and segments, and drafts outbound and event follow-up campaigns that marketers review and approve. It also learns how the team's best marketers run campaigns, such as events, webinars and product launches, and gives the whole team that workflow. Jin uses only company-approved data, and marketers see and edit what Jin learns. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Try Jin AI | Pilot the AI Outbound Agent on One Campaign](https://tryjinai.com/): Try Jin AI, the AI outbound agent for B2B marketing teams, on one campaign your team already runs.
- [Jin AI Pilot Program: Try It on One Team and One Task | tryjinai](https://tryjinai.com/pilot/): How a Jin AI pilot works: pick one repetitive task, connect the tools you already use, review what Jin prepares, and measure what changed together.

## Key facts

- Category: AI outbound agent for B2B marketing teams (also described as an AI GTM engineer for marketing teams)
- What it does: reads the team's marketing context (brand guidelines, product catalog, messaging, ICP, past campaigns, customer insights), picks target accounts and segments, and drafts outbound and event follow-up campaigns
- Best for: B2B marketing teams that want to run outbound without hiring a GTM engineer; event and webinar follow-up (for example, segmenting an attendee list and drafting follow-ups by segment); account-based outbound built on the team's own messaging
- Approval: marketers review and approve every campaign; nothing is sent without a person's approval
- Learning: Jin learns how the team's best marketers run campaigns and gives the whole team that workflow
- Trust: only company-approved data; marketers see and edit what Jin learns; never used to train AI models; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one campaign your team already runs (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
